text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hmm... And I was sure I'd be able t'catch
some
fish here...

Oho, looks like you beat me to the
punch.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Well hi there, Sky! Are you here t'do
some fish'n
too?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, I felt like a little break. I'll just sit
myself
right here next to you. ♪

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Oh, that's one!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Okay! That makes two! They're loving
this bait. ♪

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's amaz'n... I haven't caught a
single one...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
And I'm pretty confident about my fish'n
skills...

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: Have you been fishing for a long time?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Yeah! When I was little, I'd go to the
river t'catch
fish and crawdads and
whatever else was in there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I used t'make a cup with my hands and
catch 'em
with my fingers, like this.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Wait a sec... Maybe I'd have an easier
time
catch'n fish if I ditched the rod and
used my bare
hands?

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Fishing with your bare hands? Now this I
gotta
see. C'mon, show me.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe... It's kinda embarrass'n, but all
right!
Watch this!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I caught a fair few!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text: A fair few? You caught a whole school.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's all com'n back to me! The trick is
t'make a
preemptive strike!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Golly, it's been ages since I've had such
a blast... I
just wanna keep on scoop'n!

text_block_list.name: Seiun Sky
text_block_list.text:
Wow, definitely wasn't expecting you to
have
such a wild side...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
After reawakening to her dormant
talent, Yukino
Bijin is able to apply
these skills to her races and
become a
sharper runner.
